d: Short, light brown hair with straight bangs and a single curled lock framing the face. Large, expressive dark brown eyes with a startled expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a white and navy blue short-sleeved button-up shirt with a gold necktie, a navy blue mini-skirt with a brown belt, dark brown tights, and grey lace-up boots. Accessories include a black headset with olive-green earcups, a single black fingerless glove on the right hand, and a glowing red lightstick held in the right hand.
